decisions.reason: The existing message-684 MODIFY already records that mint number one receives neither a randomly allocated ticket nor commission because no prior NFT holder exists.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records the first-mint referral-commission exception and limits the $5 commission to primary mints after mint number one.
The current FAQ attributes describe rewards for successful referrals and do not assert that mint number one receives a no-referral ticket or commission.
Exempting mint number one from ticket issuance does not change the existing random-selection method, ticket weighting, eligibility window, or Chainlink VRF behavior.
The first-mint ticket exception does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw condition, or pool funding.
The metadata requirement remains valid unchanged: mint number one has neither reward, while every ticket that is accounted for must still have a corresponding commission.
The About-page copy currently says every no-code mint sends a commission and ticket to an existing holder, so it must reflect the accepted exception for mint number one.

how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used after mint number one, the commission and ticket go to a random existing ticket holder, while mint number one awards neither because no prior NFT holder exists.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each successful referral gives one on-chain ticket for the current $500 draw, and more referrals provide more chances to win; tickets expire after their draw.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: One affiliate from each 100-sales block wins $500 through a fair Chainlink VRF draw.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions and prizes are sent automatically to the user's wallet, with prize results and notifications available through the Winners page, dashboard, and email when available.

The Mission-page copy discusses successful referrals and prize selection but does not state a no-referral reward rule for mint number one.
The first-mint ticket-generation exception does not change how an actual prize winner receives a payout or notification.
